body:
The phase-five trial-data success test now fixes its synthetic clock at the latest past branch-local noon. This avoids a live-clock failure before00:03, when the production command deliberately refuses to create an earlier session today. All four explicit midnight boundary cases and production guard remain unchanged.

Only three fixture lines change; no assertion, application clock, data policy or schema changes. The normal refresh at dff6e2039957bb4f260d7161524338c339f2e881 contains main141418b06 and preserves the original7d161 test blob exactly. Independent exact-head parity review is clear.

All five focused PostgreSQL cases pass with76 assertions and a clean exit on the refreshed candidate; scoped Pint and diff checks pass. The prior head had all six CI checks green; fresh-head CI is required again before merge. Tests use an isolated synthetic database only. No production operation or deployment.
